review_text: Would never come back. Too many restrictions. It feels like a prison, especially considering how much it costs.
Very poor service. I don't want to come here again.
Poor service, dirty rooms, and a very disappointing experience. We didn’t like it at all.
Terrible service. Not recommended

Our family had dreamed of visiting Bora Bora for many years. We expected this trip to be a once-in-a-lifetime experience, but unfortunately it turned into a huge disappointment. The service at this resort is simply unacceptable. The staff are inattentive, unprofessional, and often forget even the most basic guest requests. Room cleaning was extremely poor, and many requests were either ignored or never fulfilled. Basic hygiene and toiletry items were not delivered, and we constantly had to follow up on things that should have been taken care of automatically. The management team showed little interest in resolving problems and demonstrated a lack of competence when handling guest concerns. For a resort of this level and price, this is shocking. The food was equally disappointing. We expected high-quality international and Mediterranean cuisine, but instead most of what was offered felt like ordinary American fast food. The quality, variety, and overall dining experience were far below expectations. This vacation was supposed to be a dream for our family, but it became a major disappointment because of the poor service, lack of attention to guests, and low standards throughout the resort. We will never return to this property and cannot recommend it to anyone.

Man, this is just an enormous disappointment. If there is one hotel you keep reading about as the pinnacle of paradise in your life, it surely is the Four Seasons on Bora Bora. That puts the bar high up. Unfortunately, the reality doesn't even clear a much lower bar. This is just not Four Seasons caliber. The infrastructure is dated, the restaurants are nothing special. But most importantly, it just seems like it's run by people way out of their depth. Little service, little organization, and stuff just doesn't work. Don't know if this is a recent issue - but every single family we met in French Polynesia after our stay at the Four Seasons unprompted complained about these same issues and regretted their stay. Just a huge bummer.

The resort itself is undeniably beautiful—immaculate, peaceful, and serene. From the moment you arrive, the setting washes over you with a sense of calm. The beaches are gorgeous, with soft white sand and exceptionally clear water, and the views of Mount Otemanu are truly spectacular. The lagoon and landscaped grounds are stunning, the pool is pleasant, the spa is tranquil, and the overwater bungalows are very comfortable and well designed. However, it quickly becomes apparent that the physical setting is doing most of the heavy lifting. Unfortunately, the service and food fall well short of expectations, especially given the price point. Service throughout the resort felt impersonal, inconsistent, and unrefined. Communication was frequently an issue, and interactions often lacked warmth, attentiveness, or a sense of ownership when things went wrong. Service recovery was particularly weak—mistakes were rarely acknowledged, and apologies were seldom offered. While staff were generally polite and outwardly cheerful, the experience felt surface-level rather than genuinely hospitable. Across nearly every touchpoint—front desk, restaurants, concierge, in-room dining, boutique, pool, beach, and spa—service delivery felt disorganized and careless. We regularly received mixed or conflicting information, and staff often appeared confused or disengaged. Breakfast service was often slow, with frequent order mistakes. While the offerings were acceptable, the buffet was largely unchanged day after day, becoming repetitive after only a few mornings. Food overall grew monotonous after two to three days, and pricing felt excessive relative to quality and execution. Housekeeping was also inconsistent—service times varied widely, and on one occasion our room had still not been serviced by mid-afternoon despite being vacant all day. There were also several smaller but telling lapses. At the pool, a staff member brought a jug of water and promised to return with glasses; twenty minutes later, no glasses arrived, and we ultimately had to retrieve them ourselves. Beach service was similarly lacking. In summary, Four Seasons Bora Bora delivers breathtaking natural beauty and an exceptional setting, but the service and dining experience do not match the brand's reputation or the premium prices charged.
review_title: A Stunning Setting Undermined by Disappointing Service

review_text: Good part - We stayed for six nights at the mountain view room with plunge pool and the resort is beautiful and staff is amazing. The restaurant onsite is great, the kids club is amazing for our 10 year old and villa had the best view. I will now get to the worst part. The resort allows jet skies to run in between the water villas and let me tell you it is the most annoying and disturbing thing on the property. They are constantly running very close to the line control of the villas and the noise of these jet skis completely ruins your peace with such view. You cannot relax at all in front of your water villa or lounge around nor there is any privacy as these guys are very close to the villa and constantly going up and down. To add to that one of the jet ski contractors drove inside the line of control where they are not allowed to go at high speed. This really ruined our entire experience with the non stop commotion from these jet skis, no privacy, peace and tranquility!
review_title: Exceptional hotel but with one key flaw that ruins the entire experience.

review_text: Beautiful resort, great staff, good food, but the over water bungalows are in sad need of renovation. That sums it up. We had a wonderful time in this bucket list destination. The resort is beautiful, the staff were friendly and helpful, and the food was much better than the reviews that we had seen online. But, the state of the overwater bungalows is very sad. The wood is failing in many locations and the smell of mold overpowering. We had them clean out the AC multiple times to no avail. The failed wood left visible gaps to the lagoon through the floor by the door from the inside. The wood flooring by the doors was soft from so much moisture. The black all over the doors at the bottoms it was pretty clear. It's such a beautiful resort and we had a terrific time outside of the room. But at this price point, with this premier brand, we expect much more.
review_title: Beautiful resort, but overwater bungalows in a sad need for renovation.

review_text: There is no doubt, the Four Seasons, Bora Bora, is a beautiful venue but their policy of allowing corporate events destroyed any notion of romance for us. The resort promotes itself as a couples romantic destination - one for honeymoons, 25th wedding anniversaries, a retirement treat after a life of service. We pay a very large price for this exclusivity and what are you greeted with? Sorry, you cannot access this part of the beach because of a corporate event. Another corporate is hosting a party and there will be loud music and whoops and yeehaws - so much so, you won't be able to hear the soft and romantic music in your restaurant. Also, as their guests are on a free tab, they may get a little drunk and be a little loud. When we booked our four days at this resort, we didn't expect them to sell on our access nor our quiet enjoyment. This is unforgivable.

Solid hotel, I went here as I heard it's the undisputed leader in Bora Bora. Also, as a solo traveler it was said to be more of a fit vs honeymooner heavy St Regis. It didn't meet Four Seasons expectations. The staff was friendly but they didn't go out of their way like most Four Seasons properties. No check up on the stay nor anything above and beyond. I had an issue where the Vaimiti Restaurant wouldn't let me sit by the water for one drink, despite the restaurant being nearly empty and me wearing proper attire. I shared my concern but never heard back. Even a Hilton would address that, so what a fail. The property is a bit tired and could use some upkeep vs putting it off for another year. The food was average, nothing was exquisite. Solid hotel but overpriced for what I paid and what I have seen from the Four Seasons.

The Four Seasons Bora Bora is a stunning property with beautiful grounds, including white sand beaches, an exceptional lagoon restored with coral reefs and abundant marine life, and spectacular overwater bungalows offering breathtaking views of Mount Otemanu. I can only give it four stars, as the service and especially the food fall short of the standards expected at other Four Seasons properties. While the service is generally attentive and polite, it is highly inconsistent, ranging from very basic at check in to excellent and professional in room dining. Some staff members do not speak English fluently enough, which occasionally leads to minor but awkward miscommunication. The biggest disappointment, however, is the food, particularly breakfast. Despite a fairly extensive à la carte menu, the buffet selection is extremely limited, with few fresh fruit options, a small selection of pastries, and very limited fresh juices. Dining options overall are restricted to just two restaurants, and the food quality does not justify the exorbitant prices.

Our family (spouse and adult son's family) spent four nights at the over water bungalows. The bungalows are roomy, clean and a unique experience. It was fun jumping into the water from our little deck but we spent most of our time at the beach area and resort lagoon. The pool is large but the water isn't heated, which made it a bit cold on days with rain. The activities we did were great: lagoon snorkel, shark and ray snorkel, and underwater scooter ride. All staff were very friendly and helpful. Meals were good with plenty of options. The location is beyond words in beauty.

Our stay at the Four Seasons Bora Bora was nothing short of spectacular. The service, the overwater villas, and the breathtaking lagoon setting were all absolutely perfect – a true five-star experience in every way. The only aspect that did not fully meet our expectations was the dining. While the quality was good, it did not quite match the high standards set by the rest of the resort. We were especially surprised not to find more authentic French-inspired cuisine, which we would have expected in such a unique location. Overall, an unforgettable stay that we would highly recommend – with room for improvement when it comes to the culinary experience.
review_title: Dream Stay at Four Seasons Bora Bora – but food could be better

review_text: This was our first stay at a Four Seasons. The grounds and hotel are beautiful. We loved our prime view of the mountain. The drinks were great and food was good. Where the Four Seasons stopped short for us was the service. We have stayed at many 5 star resorts (Aman, Eden Rock, One and Only, Rosewood, The Brando) and the service at Four Seasons lacked the polish and above and beyond service we're used to seeing for 5 star. Upon arrival there were not enough welcome drinks for everyone getting off the boat. Our room wasn't ready. Upon finding out our room wasn't ready we were given a sales pitch to pay to upgrade to a room category. Beach service: I was told to go find a seat on my own, had to get up and find someone to ask for waters. Golf carts were very slow, expect to wait 15 mins. Housekeeping showed up for turndown at 6:40 while we were still getting ready for a 7pm dinner. Don't expect any extra treats or snacks delivered daily to your room. Overall still a lovely stay here, but the service is not where it should be for 5 star standards.
review_title: Stunning resort but service not 5 star

review_text: We were here before, the resort is still in an excellent condition and worth the long trip. The spa and pool areas are marvellous. Unfortunately, the quality and originality of the food and restaurants have decreased over the years and do not reflect the quality of the hotel. It starts with the breakfast buffet where you only get some uninspired fruit which are offered in every star hotel. There used to be coconuts on the buffet. For dinner, you have to be really lucky to get a local fish. On the other hand, an expensive sea bass from the Mediterranean is on the menu, hard to believe. And the once very cosy restaurant on the beach is not really cosy anymore. Please improve.

We had the most amazing time at the Four Seasons. It is the most beautiful hotel and our room was so spacious. Everything from the pick up from the airport to the drop off at the end was so smooth. The snorkelling at the hotel is so good. Whilst I was at the Four Seasons I developed a really painful tooth infection. We were so grateful that there was an on site doctor and nurse. Finally, the cocktails and food were great. There was lots of variety across the different restaurants, and all the staff were really friendly.

Our stay at the Four Seasons Bora Bora was truly special. Our overwater bungalow was fantastic. There are quite a few light switches, so a quick explanation of those during check-in would have been helpful, but otherwise we loved the bungalow. The one improvement we would suggest for breakfast is more variety - the menu was essentially the same each day. There are a few areas that could use attention. We would strongly recommend having at least three working treadmills in the gym and updating some of the equipment, as we found there was barely one treadmill consistently available. The washing machine closest to our bungalow was also out of order, which meant walking to another location late in the evening to do laundry. Overall, though, these were minor issues in an otherwise outstanding stay.
review_title: An Incredible Stay Made Even More Special by the People

review_text: This place is paradise! While it's very pricey, it's worth every single cent. The accommodations are beautifully appointed, spacious, comfortable, and well-maintained. The food throughout the resort is excellent, with outstanding, attentive service. The pool and beach areas are gorgeous, clean, and vigilantly maintained. Staff in every area of the resort are well-trained, attentive, friendly, and simply amazing.
Amazing resort and excellent service

This was our 2nd time at the hotel and the 2nd time that Maja at Bora Bora Childcare looked after our 7 and 4 year old. Everything about our experience was wonderful. The team at the hotel was also fantastic and they coordinated everything so well and were really kind to the children.

An exceptional hotel that lives up to its reputation. A breathtaking place that we will remember for the rest of our lives. The Japanese restaurant is remarkable and the food is generally of good quality. The massages are divine. We do, however, regret the sometimes uneven service. The concierge service was not up to par during our stay. The showers used, given that we had a late departure and therefore no room, are appalling compared to the rest of the hotel. Camping style and very dirty... Good stay overall!

Spent 8 nights here in May. Pros of the resort: the views and property itself are stunning. Service via the Four Seasons app was extremely prompt and well-coordinated. Cons were the lunch and dinner offerings were somewhat mediocre. Food was not actively bad, but if you're from a major city like NYC, SF, etc., the food in the resort is a step down. There were also a couple of termite shavings in the bed during my stay. Overall, it was a really beautiful property and location.

We decided celebrate our 25th anniversary. We had an amazing vows renovation ceremony. Hugo our personal hostess was so open and friendly; and our Wedding planner Marine was simply AMAZING. The place, the resort, the staff, the food, the services... everything was PERFECT!

Our trip to Bora Bora was truly unforgettable. Midway through our stay, we encountered an issue that could have easily overshadowed our vacation. Thankfully, the front desk manager, Damien G, stepped in and completely turned the situation around. If there was one area that could be improved, it would be the food. While it was good, we felt there was room for improvement. That said, the spectacular surroundings, exceptional service, and incredible staff more than made up for it.

Nothing will ever top this. The views, the sea, the pool, the service. It's just perfection. We loved nearly all the food. They make everyone feel like a VIP from start to finish. If I tried to give actual feedback or point out flaws I would just be nit picking and searching for things that just aren't really there.
review_title: Spectacular. This place can never be matched.

review_text: It is an iconic hotel, with the service and food that characterize it

What a large, beautiful resort! At no point did we feel crowded. We had a delightful stay, everyone was super friendly. Food was excellent, and we felt pampered and relaxed. We had some trouble with our flights home and the concierge team helped us straighten things out.
review_title: Relaxing and outstanding stay in paradise!

review_text: Still the best hotel / resort I've ever been to. Easily. In my favorite place in the world.

From the moment we arrived we understood the experience would be of a whole new level than any other luxury hotel we had known. The staff were warm and welcoming. With more than 20 hectares, it is impossible to get bored on the resort. This trip to French Polynesia was a dream come true and the Four Seasons made it perfect and unforgettable!
review_title: A warm welcome and unforgettable experience in paradise

review_text: Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora is the definition of paradise done right. Service is exceptional, warm, attentive, and genuinely personal without being intrusive. It's undeniably a luxury splurge, but the combination of natural beauty, thoughtful design, and world-class hospitality makes it an experience you won't forget.
This place is what happens when service, views, food, and vibes all decide to overachieve at the same time. Food = incredible. Service = next level. Every single person made us feel like VIPs.
Unbelievable honeymoon at the best resort we've been to. The service was top tier from check-in to housekeeping to the awesome bar and beach staff. Never felt crowded even with most rooms booked.

Second time staying at this Four Seasons Resort. Four Seasons is better than St. Regis in poolside/beach service and breakfast variety. It says online Four Seasons opened in 2008 and St. Regis opened in 2006. I would say both of them need quite a bit remodeling. Some furniture might have changed since our last stay, but feels like more need to do. The overall service still follows their standard, except the gentleman in the concierge building behind the concierge table. He was the only one person who treated me like air ever since I went inside looking for some cups for water dispenser outside. Good thing a young girl who looks like an intern there helped me.
review_title: Second stay and would visit again

review_text: This was our fourth time staying at Four Seasons, and it continues to exceed our expectations every single visit. The resort grounds are simply breathtaking. We stayed in an overwater hale for 10 days, and it was an unforgettable experience.
review_title: Our Fourth Visit—and It Just Keeps Getting Better

review_text: This is such a beautiful resort, loved it. Our bungalow out on the water faced the mountain, such a nice view. The beach area was so nice, could walk out far. Snorkeling was great at beach and lagoon area. The food was all good and the restaurants and drinks. Everyone was so friendly. Will definitely be back, loved the resort.

The GREATEST honeymoon location on Earth! My wife and I had a magical stay, highlighted by an extremely friendly staff, a magical bungalow experience, and all the little details that show how much thought and care go into making this resort among the best in the world.

We had our wedding and honeymoon at Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora, and it was truly the experience of a lifetime. The Wedding Coordinator (Marine) and VIP Concierge team exceeded every expectation. Our overwater bungalow was pure paradise. The entire resort is immaculate, serene, and perfectly designed for romance.
review_title: Our Dream Wedding Came True in Bora Bora

review_text: My husband and I just returned from visiting multiple resorts in Bora Bora. The Four Seasons was our last night. We arrived late in the afternoon and realized that our toilet had a leak that made the floor wet. Maintenance came and determined it could not be easily fixed. Manager Jimmy came and found us at dinner and talked over the options of moving us or putting some towels on the floor. He proactively took care of our dinner. The next day, my husband could not find his passport, and Manager Veronique went to our room with security. Luckily, my husband then found it in his luggage. The fact that the managers jumped in quickly to get involved with the issues we encountered was very impressive to us.

This place is spectacular and fully lives up to all the praise, from room to resort to staff. The actual beach is a little 'coral-ly' in areas, but well kept. Snorkel lagoon is a must, there is an abundance of fish in a calm and healthy environment. Staff would stop and ask if they could help you. If you are debating between FS and anywhere else, stay here!

This was our second stay at Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora, and somehow it exceeded an already very high bar. What truly sets this resort apart is the people. The rooms are flawless, the service is out of this world. In our opinion, this resort is easily top three in the world, and the best Four Seasons.
Our Day Ray and Shark Snorkelling Safari with Otto and Tamu was truly the highlight of our honeymoon at the Four Seasons. It was a once-in-a-lifetime experience that we will cherish forever.

We stayed at the Four Seasons Bora Bora as part of our honeymoon and we couldn't be happier. We have stayed at Ritz Carlton, Hilton, W, Mandarin hotels, but what we experienced at Four Seasons for the first time was beyond anything else! All the hotel staff are super helpful and always smiling.

We had an absolutely phenomenal experience for our honeymoon at the Four Seasons in Bora Bora. The service, room, and food were absolutely perfect - I have no complaints! We cant wait to return for another special trip!

We stayed at the Four Seasons Bora Bora for a week celebrating 35 years together. What truly set this resort apart was the kindness, caring, and dedication to unmatched service provided by the entire resort team. I'm not exaggerating when I say it was the best team of people we have ever encountered anywhere.
review_title: Four Season Bora Bora - the absolute best!

review_text: We had an amazing experience at Four Seasons Bora Bora. We were truly surprised to find imported fruit at breakfast in the morning. Grapes and apples? There was no mango, papaya, pineapple or any other local fruit for the five days we were there. When we asked for mango, the waiter was told by the kitchen that they did not have any, yet ripe mangos were abundant in town. The Four Seasons would do even better to source fruit locally. At the restaurants they offer a choice of bottled still or bubbly water which are both imported from France; for the environment they should offer filtered/tap as an option.
review_title: Amazing Experience-Love the Steps they Are Taking for Environment- And a Few Suggestions

review_text: Exceptional hotel! The restaurants are of very good quality, especially with local entertainment. Special mention for the activities proposed, we tested several, all organized exceptionally (dinner on a private motu, treasure hunt, fishing, snorkeling, discovery of a pearl farm...). We just want to come back...

We had such a wonderful experience with the nanny care service at Four Seasons Bora Bora. Our nanny, Maja, was absolutely amazing! She was so warm and caring, and immediately helped ease my daughter's anxiety about being left with someone new.
review_title: Wonderful Nanny Care Experience at Four Seasons Bora Bora

review_text: Third stay at Four seasons Bora Bora and still a very good experience with high standards and rooms that are stunning. Staff are extremely friendly and professional in all areas. One caveat: the quality of the food is not up to the standard of the hotel and the choice of food and restaurants for dinner is extremely limited. Only two restaurants available in the evening, one of them being a gastro where you usually go only once during your stay. It is frustrating to be in such a nice place and have only a limited choice of food when you want to go out for dinner; the current offering does not meet a lot of guests' expectations (shared by many other visitors on top of us whilst we were there).
review_title: Four Seasons at its best....food offering can be improved
